note: The cold open (channel docs/gags.md): a ~1.5 s gag of the host caught doing something embarrassing before the reel, then a hard cut into it. Shared by reelline/media/gags.py (picks the gag, checks this file, builds the gag's sound, the props) and remotion/src/ColdOpen.tsx + gag.ts (draw it). Times in seconds from the gag's first frame; pixel values are output pixels (1080x1920). The art is assets/gags/ (tools/gags/build.py makes it from assets_src/gags/); the sounds are in the SFX library (assets/sfx/sfx.json, categories gag and scratch; tools/gags/sfx.py added them).
modeNote: on: every reel (since 2026-10-28); ab: a seeded share of the reels (abShare, per reel name) get a gag, the rest none, recorded on the reel (reels.gag, gag_mode) for the retention comparison (2026-10-25 to 10-27); off: none. The straight style (reelline/media/style.py STYLE_MODE "straight", since 2026-10-31) puts no gag on any reel whatever this says (reelline/media/gags.py mode_of()); this mode is the classic style's. scripts/render_reel.py --gag overrides both for one render (auto | none | a gag).
noRepeatNote: A gag isn't picked again while it's among the gags of the last noRepeat reels (rendered, approved or published; the reel being rendered not counted), from the database (reelline/media/gags.py recent_gags()).

timing.note: 0 to caughtS the action pose, looping (gags.<gag>.loop) under the camera's slow push-in; at caughtS the caught pose (staring at the viewer) with a zoom punch and a white flash, the record scratch; still from holdFromS; the reel starts at durationS (a hard cut). durationS and caughtS are whole frames at 30 fps.

placement.note: A gag's poses share one scale: the larger of the two (the action and the caught pose; a back pose alone) fits boxPx; each stands with its bottom on wheelsY (the front rig's wheel line) and its middle on centerX.

camera.note: The action beat's push-in from 1 to pushTo (eased), about origin (backOrigin for a back pose: between the TV and him). The caught pose's punch about punchOrigin (his face): up to punchTo over punchInS with a small overshoot, then creeping to creepTo until holdFromS. The flash: flashColor at flashOpacity from caughtS, gone over flashS.

audio.note: The gag's sound (reelline/media/gags.py gag_audio()): the action sound from 0, cut at caughtS with a fadeOutS fade; the record scratch from caughtS. Levels against the reel's own mix target (reelline/media/music.py MIX_LOUDNORM; the gag has no voice): the sfx categories' gain_db plus the gag's gainDb; each limited to ceilingDbfs (sample peak). No music under the gag: it starts with the reel, at the cut.

loopNote: The action pose's loop, in two drawings: steps 2 alternates two states every periodS / 2 (A: shake right, tilt left, down; B: shake left, tilt right, up bobPx, squashed by squash (negative: stretched; width the opposite, half as much), swollen by swell); steps 0 moves smoothly between them (a sine). The pivot is the pose's bottom middle.
